chapter: Uniforms, funeral music and horn styles
title: Clarinet style he likes: Earl Bostic, Sidney Bechet and a saxophonist named Sport
summary: Rene praises smooth clarinet and saxophone players and tries with Zander to identify a young man called Sport who came on the riverboat.
